rationale: The shortlist deliberately spans eight distinct commercial archetypes, control points, and critical dependencies while remaining unusually aligned with the founder's data-science, finance, EU-regulatory, FMCG, health-adjacent, and renewable-energy advantages. control8-04 offers a high-value recurring data-compiler wedge whose first proof can use redacted contracts and whose lineage map may become operationally sticky. control8-07 controls a formula-version release record and confidential change history, with consultant-led sandbox validation before sensitive production use. rights8-05 tests contractual first-notice and inspection rights over future battery retirements through a no-inventory dry run with permitted operators. rights8-07 tests physically scarce, contracted charging time windows through one pre-sold local cluster before hardware expansion. rights8-09 is a novel, founder-relevant safety API that can begin on synthetic data and proceed only through a compliant AISP and explicit opt-in institutional pilot. settle8-02 provides a bounded historical-statement replay against a large recurring deposit-return settlement flow. settle8-03 binds tariff, identity, meter, and invoice evidence to a repeat per-session clearing event through one narrow integration. settle8-10 begins with a paid historical deduction audit and can compound retailer-specific resolution evidence, subject to strict employer-conflict separation. Together these candidates avoid the closest delayed-history repeats in battery passports, grid preflight, white certificates, EUDAMED, cable pooling, broad CRA or AI evidence, KSeF exception handling, and PV diagnostics. Required data access, partner authority, willingness to pay, event density, and reusable-data rights remain research uncertainties rather than presumed failures.
